## Answers given
- Port: tiny-shop listens on `PORT` from the environment, 3000 when it is not set (src/config.js; src/server.js calls `server.listen(config.port)`).
- Orders: kept in memory, in a `Map` in src/store.js; they are lost when the service restarts (the README says so too).
